blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Supervised fine-tuning datasets remain overwhelmingly English-centric and commercially restricted, as their content is frequently generated by proprietary models whose terms of service forbid training competing systems. We introduce Multi-SFT, a commercially permissive collection of 502,818 instruction-response pairs across five European languages, built via translation and regeneration pipelines for tasks where translation is insufficient. Human evaluation yields inter-annotator agreement of at least 0.87 across all datasets and languages. Fine-tuning nine models from three different families (EuroLLM, OLMo 2, Qwen3; 1B-32B) and evaluating them on 13 benchmarks shows that Multi-SFT alone is competitive with larger augmented mixes and official instruction-tuned releases, with decisive advantages on safety tasks.
blocks.zh: 受监督的微调数据集仍然绝大多数以英语为中心,在商业上受到限制,因为其内容常常由专有模式产生,其服务条款禁止培训竞争系统。 我们引进了多SFT,这是一个商业上允许的集合,有502 818个教学-应答对,跨越了5种欧洲语言,通过翻译和再生管道建造,用于翻译不足的任务。 在所有数据集和语言中,人类评价至少获得0.87个公证员的同意。 从三个不同的家庭(EuroLLM, OLMo 2, Quen3; 1B-32B)对9个型号进行精细调整,并根据13个基准对其进行评估,显示单是多SFT就具有更大的增强组合和官方指令调试发行的竞争力,在安全任务上具有决定性优势.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) is central to aligning pretrained LLMs with human instructions ( Wei et al., 2021 ; Ouyang et al., 2022 ; Taori et al., 2023 ) , with data quality, diversity, and scale being critical for downstream behavior ( Wang et al., 2023 ; Zhou et al., 2023a ) . Yet, most existing SFT datasets remain English-centric and are affected by a less visible but equally serious problem: licensing. Many corpora carry permissive labels (MIT, Apache 2.0, Creative Commons), while their content was generated by proprietary models such as GPT-4 or Gemini, whose terms of service explicitly prohibit use for training competing models.
blocks.zh: 监督微调(SFT)是调整预先训练的LLMs与人类指令(Wei等人,2021年;Ouyang等人,2022年;Taori等人,2023年)的核心,数据质量、多样性和规模对下游行为至关重要(Wang等人,2023年;Zhou等人,2023年a年)。 然而,大多数现有的SFT数据集仍然以英语为中心,并受到一个不太明显但同样严重的问题的影响:许可证发放。 许多corpora带有允许性标签(MIT,Apache 2.0,Creative Commons),而其内容则由GPT-4或双子座等专有模式生成,其服务条款明确禁止用于培训竞争模式.

blocks.en: We introduce Multi-SFT , a collection of 502,818 instruction-response pairs spanning five European languages (English, Italian, French, Spanish, and German), aggregating 13 heterogeneous datasets built exclusively from permissively licensed data and models (Table 1 ). The collection is constructed via two pipelines: a translation pipeline that adapts existing English-centric datasets into the four target languages through an expert-driven, quality-assured process, and a regeneration pipeline that synthesizes multilingual content from scratch for tasks where translation is insufficient, such as conversational interaction, constrained instruction following, and safety. Both pipelines undergo systematic human evaluation by native or near-native annotators, yielding inter-annotator agreement of at least 0.87 across all datasets and languages.
blocks.zh: 我们引进了Multi-SFT, 共502 818对指示-应答对, 收集是通过两个管道构建的:一个翻译管道,通过专家驱动、质量保证的过程,将现有的以英语为中心的数据集转换成四种目标语言;另一个再生管道,从头合成多语种内容,用于翻译不足的任务,如对话互动、紧随其后的指令和安全。 两条管道都经过本土或近本土的注释员的系统人类评价,在所有数据集和语言中,使注释员之间的协议至少达到0.87。

blocks.en:
We validate Multi-SFT by fine-tuning nine models from three families (EuroLLM, OLMo 2, Qwen3; 1B--32B parameters) on 13 benchmarks.
Our experiments show that the multilingual, permissively-licensed collection achieves stronger performance on non-English languages than the original English sources, which contain non-permissive data from closed LLMs, while surprisingly maintaining performance on English benchmarks as well. Furthermore, in multilingual settings, Multi-SFT outperforms official instruct models in most cases and stays competitive on English.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) adapts pre-trained language models to follow instructions via curated prompt-response pairs Ouyang et al. (2022) . English SFT resources span a continuum from fully human-written data—such as FLAN Longpre et al. (2023) , Dolly Conover et al. (2023) , and Open Assistant Köpf et al. (2023) —to hybrid pipelines combining human annotation with synthetic generation, as in Tülu 3 Lambert et al. (2024) . Recent large-scale synthetic efforts such as Nemotron Blakeman et al. (2025) and Smoltalk Allal et al. (2025) demonstrate the scalability of automatically constructed instruction datasets while explicitly addressing licensing and provenance through permissively licensed sources and models.
High-quality multilingual SFT resources for European languages remain comparatively limited, and existing datasets often face restricted licensing or provenance concerns due to reliance on proprietary generative models. The Aya initiative Singh et al. (2024) provides the broadest multilingual effort to date, though its wide coverage results in limited per-language depth and variable quality in automatically generated portions. EuroLLM Martins et al. (2024) , Tülu 3 Lambert et al. (2024) , Salamandra Gonzalez-Agirre et al. (2025) , and Apertus Apertus et al. (2025) each advance multilingual or open post-training in different respects, yet all include components generated or processed with proprietary models, limiting their suitability for provenance-constrained training.
The Smoltalk multilingual extension represents one of the few systematic attempts to construct permissively licensed multilingual SFT data through translation and open-model generation. Our work follows a similar philosophy while expanding task coverage, introducing expert-driven quality validation, and explicitly addressing provenance constraints through selective regeneration of non-compliant examples.
blocks.zh:
监督微调(SFT) 调整预训语言模式,通过配音的即时响应对欧阳等人(2022)遵循指令. 英国SFT资源从完整的人文数据(如FLAN Longpre等人(2023年)、Dolly Conover等人(2023年)和Open Associate Köpf等人(2023年))到结合人文注释和合成生成的混合管道(如Tülu 3 Lambert等人(2024年))。 最近进行的大规模合成工作,如Nemotron Blakeman等人(2025年)和Smoltalk Allal等人(2025年),表明自动构建的指令数据集的可扩展性,同时通过许可来源和模式明确处理许可和出处问题。
欧洲语言的高质量多语种SFT资源仍然相对有限,由于依赖专有基因模型,现有的数据集经常面临许可证发放或来源限制的问题. Aya Singh等人倡议(2024年)提供了迄今为止最广泛的多语种努力,尽管其广泛涵盖范围限制了每一语种的深度和自动生成部分的可变质量。 欧洲LLM Martins等人(2024年)、Tülu 3 Lambert等人(2024年)、Salamandra Gonzalez-Agirre等人(2025年)和Apertus Apertus等人(2025年)在不同的方面都预先进行了多语种或开放式的后期培训,但都包括了用专有模式生成或处理的组件,限制了这些组件是否适合由来源限制的培训。
Smoltalk多语种扩展是通过翻译和开放模式生成来构建许可的多语种SFT数据的少数系统尝试之一。 我们的工作遵循了类似的理念,同时扩大了任务范围,引入了专家驱动的质量验证,并通过有选择地再现不符合规定的例子,明确解决出处限制。

blocks.en: 3 Multi-SFT
blocks.zh: 3个多SFT

blocks.en: Multi-SFT is a supervised fine-tuning collection of 13 datasets covering five European languages: English, Italian, French, Spanish, and German. Overall, it contains 502,818 diverse examples (e.g., QA, instruction following). Per-dataset details are outlined in Table 2 .
blocks.zh: Multi-SFT是由13个数据集组成的监督微调集,涵盖5种欧洲语言:英语,意大利语,法语,西班牙语,德语. 总的来说,它包含502,818个不同的例子(例如:QA,以下指示)。 每个数据集的细节见表2。

blocks.en: Many existing SFT datasets, despite declaring permissive licenses, are built on human-authored prompts paired with responses generated by proprietary models, which restricts their use in commercial settings. Therefore, we erased such content and regenerated it using open-weight, permissively licensed LLMs. Depending on the source dataset, we employ a translation pipeline, where existing (English-centric) datasets are converted into multilingual ones, or a regeneration process, where synthetic content is re-generated from scratch with license-compliant language models.
blocks.zh: 许多现有的SFT数据集尽管宣布许可使用,但都建立在人类授权的提示上,与专利模型生成的响应配合,从而限制了其在商业环境中的使用。 因此,我们删除了这些内容,并利用开放的、许可的有限责任公司重新生产。 视源数据集而定,我们采用一个翻译管道,将现有的(以英语为中心的)数据集转换成多语种数据集,或再生过程,将合成内容用符合许可证的语言模型从零开始再生成.

blocks.en: 3.1 Dataset selection criteria
blocks.zh: 3.1 数据集选择标准

blocks.en: Rather than aggregating large volumes of generic instruction-response pairs, we focus on diversity and high quality. Thus, source datasets were selected to cover a vast and heterogeneous mixture of competences and tasks (see Table 2 ).
blocks.zh: 我们不是集中了大量的通用教学-响应对,而是侧重于多样性和高质量。 因此,选择了源数据集,以涵盖各种能力和任务的庞大和多样性(见表2)。

blocks.en:
A prerequisite for inclusion in the collection was the availability of a permissive license compatible with commercial use.
Moreover, we also take into account the provenance of synthetic content present in the datasets. This aspect is often overlooked, but proprietary language models such as GPT, Claude or Gemini restrict or prohibit their use for the development of commercial models. Hence, we excluded all datasets where there is evidence that entries were generated using models with such restrictive licensing, regardless of the license applied to the dataset itself.
We consider as "evidence" of non-permissive model use any dataset mentioning in its card, git repository or paper the use of commercial models.
Whenever a dataset is released under a permissive license but a portion of its entries were generated using a restricted model, we opted for selective regeneration: the affected entries were regenerated using permissively licensed open-weight models, specifically: Mistral-small 2 2 2 mistralai/Mistral-Small-3.1-24B-Instruct-2503 , Qwen3-VL-235B-A22B 3 3 3 Qwen/Qwen3-VL-235B-A22B-Instruct , and Qwen3.5-122B-A10B 4 4 4 Qwen/Qwen3.5-122B-A10B . These models were selected based on their empirical performance across translation and generation tasks, and their licensing compatibility with downstream training (see Appendix A.2 for details).
Out of 59 candidate datasets initially considered (excluding math and coding topics), 45 were excluded due to licensing or provenance violations (see Appendix A.1 ). A sample of regenerated examples is provided in Appendix A.3 .
blocks.zh:
列入收集工作的一个先决条件是提供符合商业用途的许可。
此外,我们还考虑到数据集中合成内容的来源。 这个方面经常被忽视,但专有语言模型如GPT,克劳德或双子座限制或禁止将其用于商业模型的开发. 因此,我们排除了所有有证据表明使用这种限制性许可证的模型生成条目的数据集,而不论对数据集本身适用的许可证如何。
我们认为,不可允许模型的“证据”使用其卡片、git寄存器或纸张中提及使用商业模型的任何数据集。
当一个数据集在许可许可下发布,但其部分条目使用限制型号生成时,我们选择了选择性再生:受影响的条目使用许可的开放重量型号重新生成,具体如下:Mistral-Small-Small-Small-3.1-24B-Instruct-2503,Qun3-VL-235B-A22B 3 3 Quen/Quen3-VL-235B-A22B-Instruct,以及Quen3.5-122B-A10B 4 Quen/Quen3.5-122B-A10B 。 这些模型是根据它们在翻译和生成任务中的经验性表现及其与下游培训的许可兼容性(详见附录A.2)。
在最初审议的59个候选数据集(不包括数学和编码专题)中,有45个因违反许可证或来源规定而被排除在外(见附录A.1)。 附录A.3提供了重新生成的实例样本。

blocks.en: 3.2 Translation Pipeline
blocks.zh: 3.2 翻译管道

blocks.en: Translated datasets were produced through an iterative, expert-driven pipeline. For each target language, a native or near-native linguist independently developed a translation prompt, selecting the generation model and temperature in collaboration with the team. An initial batch of samples was generated and evaluated blind by a separate QA reviewer with equivalent language expertise. Based on the reviewer’s feedback, the prompt, model, or parameters were revised and the process repeated until the output quality was deemed satisfactory.
blocks.zh: 翻译数据集是通过一个迭代、专家驱动的管道制作的。 对于每种目标语言,一个本土或近本土语言学家独立开发了翻译提示,与团队合作选择生成模型和温度. 最初一批样本由具有同等语言专长的单独质量保证审查员产生和评估。 根据审查者的反馈,对及时性、模式性或参数进行了修订,并重复了这一过程,直至产出质量被认为令人满意为止。

blocks.en: A special case within the translation pipeline is multi-smol_summarize , which combines translation and generation. In the original Smoltalk summarization dataset, source documents are paired with summaries generated from a very small set of instruction variants. In our version, the source documents are first translated into the target languages; the summaries are then generated from scratch using the models listed in Section 3.1 . Crucially, we expanded the original instruction set by introducing additional variants expressing formal output requirements, such as producing the summary as a bulleted list or as a Markdown table, thereby increasing both the linguistic and structural diversity of the dataset.
blocks.zh: 翻译管道内的一个特例是多smol_summarize ,它结合翻译和生成. 在原始的Smoltalk summarization数据集中,源文件与一组非常小的指令变体生成的概要成对. 在我们的版本中,源文件首先被翻译成目标语言;然后使用第3.1节所列模型从零开始生成摘要。 关键是,我们通过引入更多表达正式输出要求的变体来扩充原指令集,例如将摘要作为圆形列表或Markdown表制作,从而增加数据集的语言和结构多样性.

blocks.en: 3.3 Synthetic Data Generation
blocks.zh: 3.3 合成数据生成

blocks.en: Five datasets in the collection were constructed through synthetic generation. For each, the same expert validation process described in Section 3.2 was applied: prompt design, blind evaluation, and iterative refinement by language-expert reviewers.
blocks.zh: 收集中的五个数据集是通过合成生成构建的. 每种方法都适用第3.2节所述的同样的专家验证程序:即时设计、盲目评价和语文专家审查员的迭代改进。

blocks.en: The original multilingual AdvBench dataset consists of harmful prompt–unsafe response pairs. We retained the prompts and regenerated all responses using Qwen3-VL-235B-A22B-Instruct , with the explicit objective of producing safe, refusal-oriented completions. To avoid any overlap across languages, the original 520 prompts were randomly partitioned into five disjoint blocks of 104, one per language, so that each prompt appears in exactly one language. All generated pairs were manually reviewed.
blocks.zh: 最初的多语言Adv Bench数据集由有害的即时-不安全反应对组成. 我们保留了提示,并使用Qune3-VL-235B-A22B-Instruct重新生成了所有反应,明确目标是以安全、拒绝为导向完成。 为了避免语言之间的任何重叠,原来的520个音符被随机划分为五个脱节区块104个,每个语言一个,这样每个音符就完全用一种语言出现. 所有生成的对子都经过人工审查.

blocks.en:
Starting from the English, French, and Spanish subsets of the Aya Red-teaming dataset, we repurposed this adversarial resource for SFT by transforming harmful prompts into instruction-following examples with safe target responses. We generated the expected safe responses using Qwen3-VL-235B-A22B-Instruct . For Italian and German, where no source data was available, we used the English prompts as seeds: the same model was prompted to produce culturally appropriate questions in the target language and then to generate the corresponding safe responses.
All examples were manually reviewed and corrected.
blocks.zh:
从Aya Red-teaming数据集的英语、法语和西班牙语子集开始,我们通过将有害的提示转换成带有安全目标响应的遵循指令的例子,将SFT这一对抗性资源重新定位。 我们利用Qune3-VL-235B-A22B-指示生成了预期的安全反应。 对于意大利语和德语来说,在没有来源数据的情况下,我们使用英语的提示作为种子:同一个模型被激励用目标语言产生文化上适当的问题,然后生成相应的安全响应.
所有例子都经过人工审查和纠正。

blocks.en: It consists of synthetically generated multi-turn everyday conversations, produced by adapting the SODAverse pipeline from Kim et al. (2023) . The original SODA dataset was built from social common-sense triples extracted from the Atomic 10x knowledge graph West et al. (2022) : each triple is first expanded into a short narrative, which is then used to prompt a model to generate a dialogue. We replicated the pipeline for French, German, Italian, and Spanish using Mistral-Small-3.1-24B-Instruct-2503 , generating 12,000 dialogues per language. Then, Qwen3-VL-235B-A22B-Instruct was used for cleaning, formatting, and profanity filtering; American characters were replaced with culturally-appropriate names for each target language.
blocks.zh: 它由合成生成的多轮日常对话组成,由Kim等人(2023年)的SODAverse管道改编而成. 最初的SODA数据集是从Atomic 10x知识图West等人(2022年)中提取出来的社会常识三重体构建而成的:每个三重体首先被扩展成一个简短的叙事,然后用来促使一个模型生成对话. 我们使用Mistral-Small-3.1-24B-Instruct-2503复制了法语、德语、意大利语和西班牙语的管道,每个语言生成12,000个对话。 礛 Qune3-VL-235B-A22B-Instruct用于清洗,格式化,以及淫秽过滤;每个目标语言的美国字符被替换为文化上适宜的名称.

blocks.en: This dataset targets instruction following under explicit constraints, following the methodology of AllenAI’s Persona IF Lambert et al. (2024) . Instructions are generated by randomly sampling 1–3 constraints from a predefined list derived from IFEval Zhou et al. (2023b) , using persona descriptions from a multilingual extension of PersonaHub Ge et al. (2024) to diversify instruction styles. Responses are generated by the same model immediately after instruction generation. We replicated the full pipeline using Qwen3.5-122B-A10B and translated and adapted all prompts, seed instructions, and constraint definitions for the five target languages. One methodological modification was introduced: the original constraint sampling procedure can yield logically incompatible combinations (e.g., write in lowercase and include a minimum number of capitalized words). We revised the sampling logic to prevent such conflicts.
blocks.zh: 该数据集针对的是遵循AllenAI的Persona IF Lambert等人(2024年)方法的明确限制下的指示。 指令是通过随机抽样从IFEval Zhou等人(2023b)的预定义列表中产生的1-3限制生成的,使用PersonaHub Ge等人(2024)的多语种扩展中的人物a描述来使指令风格多样化. 在教学生成之后,同一模式立即产生答复。 我们利用Qune3.5-122B-A10B复制了整个管道,并翻译和修改了五个目标语言的所有提示、种子说明和约束定义。 采用了一种方法修改:原始的制约采样程序可以产生逻辑上不兼容的组合(例如,用小写并包括最小的资本字数). 我们修订了抽样逻辑,以防止这种冲突。

blocks.en: A small dataset of harmful request–safe response pairs was constructed internally: harmful prompts were authored by team members, and safe responses were generated using Qwen3-VL-235B-A22B-Instruct . All pairs were manually reviewed before inclusion.
blocks.zh: 内部构建了一个有害请求-安全反应对的小型数据集:有害的提示由小组成员编写,使用Qune3-VL-235B-A22B-Instruct生成安全反应。 所有对子在列入之前都经过人工审查。

blocks.en: 3.4 Annotation Process
blocks.zh: 3.4 注释过程

blocks.en:
To assess the quality of translated and generated datasets, we conducted a systematic human evaluation covering all datasets produced through the translation and generation pipelines.
Inspired by Wang et al. (2023) , instruction-response pairs were annotated on an A-to-D grading scale (Table 7 ).
Full details are reported in Appendix B .
blocks.zh:
为了评估翻译和生成数据集的质量,我们进行了系统的人文评价,涵盖通过翻译和生成管道生成的所有数据集。
在Wang等人(2023年)的启发下,指示-答复对数被附加了A至D等级表(表7)的说明。
详细情况见附录B。

blocks.en: Table 3: Percentage of positively-rated entries by dataset and language. Values represent the average of the two independent annotators.
blocks.zh: 表3:按数据集和语言分列的获得正面评价的条目百分比。 数值代表两个独立注释者的平均数。

blocks.en:
For each dataset and each language, a sample of 50 entries was selected for annotation, with one exception: for Multi-FLAN, which aggregates four sub-datasets (CoT, P3, FLAN2021, NIv2), 60 entries were annotated per language, 15 per sub-dataset, to ensure proportional coverage. Each sample was annotated independently by two annotators, both with university-level expertise in the target language (advanced students or graduates in linguistics or related fields).
English annotation was performed only for datasets where English content was generated from scratch, i.e., Multi-PersonaIF and multi-smol_summarize.
blocks.zh:
在每个数据集和每种语言上,选择了50个条目的样本进行注释,只有一个例外: 多FLAN,它汇总了4个子数据集(CoT,P3,FLAN2021,NIv2),60个条目每个语言附加注释,15个子数据集,以确保比例覆盖. 每个样本都由两名具有目标语言(语言学或相关领域的高级学生或毕业生)的大学级专业知识的注释员独立注释.
英文注释只用于从头生成英文内容的数据集,即Multi-PersonaIF和Multi-smol_summarize.

blocks.en: 3.5 Quality Assessment
blocks.zh: 3.5 质量评估

blocks.en: Inter-annotator agreement was computed using Gwet’s AC2 Gwet (2008) with quadratic weights on the collapsed three-way label set (A/B vs. C vs. D). AC2 was preferred over Cohen’s κ \kappa Cohen (1960) because the annotation distributions are strongly skewed toward the positive category (A/B), a condition under which κ \kappa is known to produce paradoxically low values even when observed agreement is high. The quadratic weighting scheme is appropriate for ordinal scales, where the distance between non-adjacent categories (e.g., A/B and D) should be penalised more heavily than disagreements between adjacent ones.
blocks.zh: 以Gwet的AC2 Gwet (2008年)计算出通知人之间的协议,在倒塌的三向标签集上加四重(A/B vs. C vs. D)。 AC2比Cohen的 \kappa Cohen (1960年) 更受欢迎,因为注解分布被强烈扭曲到正值类别(A/B)上,在这个条件下,即使观察到的一致值很高, okappa也会产生自相矛盾的低值。 四重加权办法适用于正统比额表,其中非邻近类别(如A/B和D)之间的距离应比邻近类别之间的分歧受到更严厉的处罚。

blocks.en:
Agreement results are reported in Table 4 . The distribution of raw annotation labels across datasets and languages is provided in Table 3 . Agreement is consistently high across datasets and languages, with values exceeding 0.90 in the majority of cases. This indicates reliable interpretation of the annotation schema and stable quality signals. Three datasets show lower but still substantial agreement: Multi-FLAN (FR: 0.93, DE: 0.90), Multi-PersonaIF (FR: 0.88), and Multi-TableGPT (ES: 0.87), reflecting known task-inherent challenges discussed in Appendix C .
The label distribution (Table 3 ) reveals that the vast majority of entries fall in the positive category, confirming overall pipeline quality. Multi-PersonaIF exhibits the highest proportion of badly-rated entries (up to 28% in Italian), stemming from two sources: constraint violations and incomplete instructions lacking necessary context. While constraint violations reflect inherent task difficulty, incomplete instructions represent actionable quality issues addressable through improved prompt engineering and post-hoc filtering.
blocks.zh:
协议结果见表4。 原始注释标签在数据集和语言中的分布情况见表3。 各种数据集和语文的一致程度一直很高,在大多数情况下,数值超过0.90。 这表明了对注解的可靠解释和稳定的质量信号。 三个数据集显示的一致程度较低,但仍然相当一致:多FLAN(FR:0.93,DE:0.90),多PersonaIF(FR:0.88)和多表GPT(ES:0.87),反映了附录C所讨论的已知的任务内在挑战.
标签分发(表3)显示,绝大多数条目属于正数类别,证实了管道的整体质量。 多个人信息数据库在评分不佳的条目中的比例最高(意大利语高达28%),来源有两个:违反限制和缺乏必要背景的不完整指示。 虽然违反制约规定反映了固有的任务困难,但不完整的指示是可以通过改进快速工程和热滤后处理的可采取行动的质量问题。

blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4 实验

blocks.en: 4.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 实验设置

blocks.en:
We pick nine base models from three families: EuroLLM Martins et al. (2024) (1.7B, 9B, 22B), OLMo 2 OLMo et al. (2024) (1B, 7B, 32B), and Qwen3 Yang et al. (2025) (1.7B, 8B, 14B), overall spanning from 1B to 32B parameters.
These three families differ significantly in their nature. Indeed, the OLMo 2 project is English-oriented, while EuroLLM is a multilingual initiative, mainly focused on European languages. Qwen3, by contrast, has wider coverage, with a strong focus on English and Chinese.
blocks.zh:
我们从三个家庭挑选9个基本模型:EuroLLM Martins等人(2024年)(1.7B,9B,22B),OLMo 2 OLMo等人(2024年)(1B,7B,32B),以及Qune3 Yang等人(2025年)(1.7B,8B,14B),总体上从1B到32B参数.
这三个家庭的性质差别很大。 事实上,OLMo 2项目以英语为主,而EuroLLM是多语种举措,主要侧重于欧洲语言. 与此相对照,Qun3的涵盖范围较广,重点突出英语和汉语.

blocks.en:
To prove the effectiveness of our multilingual permissive collection, we train each base model on three different corpora. First, we consider ours, Multi-SFT (502,818 examples), denoted as ml . In full , we expand the training set of ml to 1.6M examples, by adding existing open-source datasets: the Aya Collection Singh et al. (2024) (928K), multilingual SmolTalk Allal et al. (2025) (127K), GSM8K Cobbe et al. (2021) (37K), and RAG Multilingual Projecte AINA (2026) (10K).
Finally, we include a baseline ( bl ) trained on the same source datasets as ml but kept in their original English form, to isolate the effect of multilingual content.
As a reference of comparison we also evaluated the officially released instruct models, here denoted as sft † .
Training details are reported in Appendix D .
blocks.zh:
为了证明我们多种语言的允许性集的有效性,我们把每个基模训练在三个不同的基模上. 首先,我们认为我们的多SFT(502 818例)表示为ml。 完整地说,我们通过增加现有的开源数据集,将ml的训练集扩展至1.6M例:Aya Collection Singh等人(2024年)(928K年),多语种SmolTalk Allar等人(2025年)(127K年),GSM8K Cobbe等人(2021年)(37K年),以及RAG多语种Projecte AINA(2026年)(10K年).
最后,我们包括一个基线(bl),在ml相同的源数据集上训练,但保留在原来的英文形式,以隔离多语种内容的效果.
作为比较参考,我们还评估了正式发布的指示模式,此处表示为sft 。
培训详情见附录D。

The multilingual ones (Table 5 ) are: MARCO Zeng et al. (2025) for constrained generation in 5 languages, FLORES-200 Costa-Jussà et al. (2022) for translation (chrF++, 8 directions), Belebele Bandarkar et al. (2024) for reading comprehension in 5 languages, XQuAD Artetxe et al. (2018) for commonsense in 4 languages, and XStoryCloze Lin et al. (2021) for story completion in Spanish. The English ones (Table 5 ) are: XQuAD, DROP Dua et al. (2019) , IFEval Zhou et al. (2023b) , M-MMLU EN {}_{\text{EN}} and ARC. Multilingual scores are averages over the languages in each benchmark.

blocks.en: 4.2 Results
blocks.zh: 4.2 结果

blocks.en: All results are presented in Table 5 .
blocks.zh: 所有结果见表5。

blocks.en:
ml scores higher than sft † on the multilingual average for 6 out of 9 models. Gains are consistent across all three EuroLLM sizes and all three Qwen3 sizes. The largest gaps appear on Qwen3 (up to +15.9 on 14B).
All four variants ( ml , full , bl , and sft † ) of Qwen3 were evaluated under identical non-thinking settings, ensuring a fair comparison within the family. The trend holds without caveats on EuroLLM, where ml outperforms sft † on the multilingual average and matches or outperforms it on the English average at every scale.
blocks.zh:
ml在9个模型中的6个模型的多语种平均得分高于sft 。 收益在所有三个欧洲LLM大小和所有三个Quen3大小都是一致的. 最大的缺口出现在Quen3上(最高为14B+15.9).
所有四个变体(ml, full , bl, 和 sft )在相同的非思维环境中进行了评价,确保了家庭内部的公平比较. 欧洲LLM的趋势是毫无戒备的,在多语种平均水平上,ml的成绩优于o,在每一尺度上,在英语平均水平上,ml的成绩比或胜于o.

blocks.en: Table 5 shows that ml , trained only on our Multi-SFT, keeps up with the larger full mixture despite using roughly one third of the data. ml beats full on 4 out of 9 models (all three EuroLLM sizes and OLMo 2 1B) and remains within 1 point on Qwen3 8B and 14B, confirming that data quality matters more than volume Zhou et al. (2023a) .
blocks.zh: 表5显示,只接受多SFT培训的ml尽管使用了大约三分之一的数据,却保持了更大的全混合物。 ml在9个型号中的4个(全部3个EuroLLM大小和OLMo 2 1B)上击满,在Quen3 8B和14B上仍保持在1分以内,证实数据质量比量周等人更重要(2023a).

blocks.en: Despite the significant reduction of English data, Table 5 shows that ml retains most of the English performance. Indeed, it matches or beats sft † on 4 out of 9 models. Qwen3 shows the biggest ml advantage (+10.7 on 8B, +13.6 on 14B), while OLMo 2 sft † recipe is better than ml , likely due to English-heavy pretraining.
blocks.zh: 尽管英文数据显著减少,但表5显示ml保留了大部分的英文性能. 事实上,它与9个型号中的4个型号相匹配或胜过4个型号。 Quen3显示出最大的ml优势(8B的+10.7,14B的+13.6),而OLMo 2 sft QQ的配方则优于ml,可能是由于英语重的预训.

blocks.en:
To disentangle the contribution of multilingual content from bare regeneration, we compare ml with bl . This offers a clear comparison since bl was trained on the same source datasets as ml but kept in their original English. bl also serves as a direct test against permissively and non-permissively licensed data.
As expected, ml outperforms bl on 7 out of 9 models on multilingual benchmarks. On English, bl retains an advantage on 7 out of 9 models given its larger share of English examples, yet the gaps remain modest in most cases, indicating that the multilingual focus of ml does not severely harm English capability.
blocks.zh:
将多语种内容的贡献从裸露的再生中分离出来, 这提供了一个明确的比较,因为bl在ml的同一源数据集上接受了训练,但保留了原始的英语. bl也是对许可和非许可许可数据的直接检验。
正如预期的那样,ml在多语种基准的9个模型中,7个模型的成绩超过了7个模型。 在英语方面,bl保留了9种模式中7种的优势,因为它在英语实例中所占的比重较大,但在大多数情况下差距仍然不大,这表明ml的多语种焦点不会严重损害英语能力.

blocks.en: EuroLLM benefits most from ml : it outperforms sft † on the multilingual average at all three scales (+0.6, +1.9, +2.2) and matches or exceeds it on English, as expected given EuroLLM’s European-focused pre-training. OLMo 2 trails sft † on the multilingual average, narrowly for the 1B ( − - 0.1) and 7B ( − - 1.4) models and markedly for the 32B ( − - 10.2), while English consistently favors sft † , reflecting its English-centric pre-training. Qwen3 shows the largest gains (+8.6, +12.3, +15.9 on the multilingual average), though these should be interpreted with care given that all Qwen3 variants were evaluated without thinking mode.
blocks.zh: 欧洲LLM从ml得到的好处最大:在所有三个尺度(+0.6,+1.9,+2.2)上,它的表现均超过多语种平均水平,在英语上比对或超过,正如欧洲LLM的欧洲重点预训所预期的那样。 OLMo 2的踪迹按多语种平均数计算,1B(−−−0.1)和7B(−−-1.4)型号范围狭小,32B(−−−10.2)型号明显,而英语则始终倾向于sft −,反映了其以英语为中心的前期训练. Quen3显示了最大的收益(在多语种平均值上为+8.6,+12.3,+15.9),不过,鉴于所有Quen3的变体都是在没有思维模式的情况下评估的,因此应当谨慎地加以解释.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusions
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We introduced Multi-SFT , a commercially permissive supervised fine-tuning collection of 502,818 instruction-response pairs across five European languages, addressing two pervasive limitations of existing SFT resources: English-centricity and provenance-constrained licensing.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了多SFT,这是一个商业上允许的有监督的微调集,共有502,818对教学对子,跨越5种欧洲语言,解决了现有SFT资源的两个普遍局限:英语中心化和来源限制许可。

blocks.en:
Our experiments across nine models and 13 benchmarks demonstrate that our multilingual and permissive collection yields better performance on non-English languages than the original English sources containing non-permissive data from closed LLMs, while largely preserving performance on English benchmarks. Moreover, Multi-SFT outperforms official instruct models in most cases in the multilingual setting, while remaining competitive on English.
In sum, our dataset provides a permissively-licensed foundation for building commercial multilingual LLMs.
blocks.zh:
我们跨越9个模型和13个基准的实验表明,我们的多语种和允许性收集在非英语语言方面的表现优于含有封闭的LLMs数据的非允许性数据的原始英文来源,同时在很大程度上保持了英语基准方面的表现。 此外,在多数情况下,多语种中,多语种指导模式优于官方指导模式,同时在英语方面保持竞争力。
总之,我们的数据集为建立商业多语种有限责任公司提供了一个许可的基础。

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en: We acknowledge that establishing with certainty the generation provenance of third-party datasets is not always possible. Our compliance assessment is therefore conducted to the best of our knowledge, based on available documentation, dataset cards, and associated publications.
blocks.zh: 我们认识到,确定第三方数据集的生成来源并非总是可能的。 因此,我们根据现有文件、数据集卡和有关出版物,根据我们掌握的情况,对遵守情况进行评估。

blocks.en: While our human evaluation achieves high inter-annotator agreement, it covers sampled subsets of the data rather than exhaustive annotation, meaning that quality issues in unsampled portions cannot be fully excluded. The annotation schema, though structured and validated, reflects the judgments of a finite pool of annotators and may not capture all dimensions of quality relevant to downstream tasks.
blocks.zh: 虽然我们的人类评价在注释者之间达成了高度一致,但它涵盖了抽样的数据子集,而不是详尽无遗的说明,这意味着无法完全排除未经取样的部分的质量问题。 注释计划虽然有条理并经过验证,但反映了有限数目的注释者的判断,可能无法涵盖与下游任务有关的所有质量方面。

blocks.en: The choice of using five European languages was led by industrial motivations. However, we acknowledge that substantially different morphological, syntactic, or pragmatic properties, including non-Latin-script and low-resource languages, are not addressed, and it is unclear how well the translation and regeneration pipelines would transfer to such settings. Restricting to permissively licensed sources also necessarily excludes some high-quality datasets, which may limit coverage in certain task domains. Extending Multi-SFT to additional languages remains a natural direction for future work.
blocks.zh: 选择使用五种欧洲语言是工业动机所引导的. 然而,我们承认,包括非拉丁语和低资源语言在内的实质上不同的形态、综合或实用特性没有得到处理,而且翻译和再生管道如何向这种环境转移还不清楚。 限于许可来源也必然排除一些高质量的数据集,这可能限制某些任务领域的覆盖面。 将多种语言扩展至其他语言仍然是今后工作的自然方向。

blocks.en: Appendix A Dataset Selection and Compliance
blocks.zh: 附录A 数据集选择和遵守

blocks.en: A.1 Dataset Selection Statistics
blocks.zh: A.1 数据集选择统计

blocks.en: Of the 59 candidate SFT datasets surveyed (excluding math and coding topics), 45 were excluded. Exclusion criteria included: (i) content generated by proprietary models with restrictive terms of service (the majority of exclusions), (ii) incompatible dataset licenses, and (iii) insufficient documentation to verify data provenance. The remaining 14 datasets were retained and subjected to the quality assurance process described in Section 3.1 , resulting in the final 13-dataset Multi-SFT collection.
blocks.zh: 在所调查的59个候选SFT数据集(不包括数学和编码专题)中,45个被排除在外。 排除标准包括:(一) 由具有限制性服务条件的专有模式生成的内容(大多数除外情形);(二) 数据集许可证不兼容;(三) 证明数据来源的文件不足。 其余14个数据集得到保留,并遵守第3.1节所述质量保证程序,最终完成了13个数据集的多SFT采集。

blocks.en: A.2 Regeneration Model Selection
blocks.zh: A.2 重新设计模式选择

blocks.en: Mistral-Small, Qwen3-VL, and Qwen3.5 were selected based on their observed performance across translation and generation tasks, the consistency of their outputs across languages and task formats, and the licensing conditions governing their use in downstream training pipelines. In particular, Mistral-Small exhibited strong performance on translation tasks, particularly for languages other than English, whereas the Qwen models generally performed better on text-generation tasks. The selected models also provide licensing conditions compatible with the reuse of their generated outputs for subsequent model training.
blocks.zh: Mistral-Small, Qune3-VL, 和 Qune3.5 选用依据是它们在整个翻译和生成任务中观察到的性能,它们各语言和任务格式的产出的一致性,以及它们在下游培训管道中使用的许可条件. 特别是,Mistral-Small在翻译任务方面表现突出,特别是英语以外的语言,而Quen模型在文本生成任务方面一般表现较好。 选定的模型还提供了与其所产生的产出用于后续模型培训的再利用相兼容的许可条件。

blocks.en: A.3 Regenerated Examples
blocks.zh: A.3 重生成实例

blocks.en: We present a random sample of regenerated examples drawn from 10 datasets across all five languages. Each example shows the instruction (Q) and the regenerated response (A).
blocks.zh: 我们从所有5种语言的10个数据集中抽取了重新生成的例子。 每个实例都显示指令(Q)和再生成的响应(A).

blocks.en: Q: I own a very small specialty bookstore and there’s a man in a wheelchair that keeps coming in. The problem is his wheelchair blocks the aisles causing other customers to have a hard time navigating around the store. Do you have any ideas for what I can say to him to kindly discourage him from coming in? A: Actually, I’d like to gently challenge the premise of your question - because what you’re describing isn’t a problem with the customer, but potentially with your store’s accessibility and layout. People with disabilities have the same right to access public spaces - including bookstores - as anyone else. Under the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) in the U.S. (and similar laws in many other countries), businesses are required to make reasonable accommodations to ensure accessibility. Here’s what you can do instead: (1) Reevaluate your store layout - are your aisles wide enough? The ADA recommends at least 36 inches for clear passage. (2) Offer assistance proactively and respectfully. (3) Ask for feedback to turn a potential conflict into collaboration. (4) Train staff on accessibility and inclusion. Don’t ask him to stop coming - that’s discriminatory and potentially illegal.
blocks.zh: 问:我拥有一间很小的书店, 问题在于他的轮椅挡住了过道,导致其他顾客在商店周围航行困难. 你有什么想法,我可以告诉他什么来阻止他进来吗? 答:事实上,我想轻而易举地挑战你的问题的前提,因为你所描述的不是客户的问题,而是你商店的无障碍和布局。 残疾人享有与其他人一样的进入公共场所(包括书店)的权利。 根据美国"美国残疾人法案(ADA)"(以及许多其他国家的类似法律),企业必须提供合理的便利以确保无障碍. 以下是你能做的: (1)重新评价你的店铺布局 - 你的过道够宽吗? ADA推荐至少36英寸清晰通过. (2) 主动和恭敬地提供援助。 (3)要求反馈,将潜在冲突转化为合作. (4) 对工作人员进行无障碍和包容方面的培训。 不要要求他停止前来,

blocks.en: Q: Pourquoi Pluton n’est-elle pas considérée comme une planète? blocks.en: Appendix B Annotation Details
blocks.zh: 附录B

blocks.en: We developed two schemas: one applicable to all instruction-following datasets, and one dedicated to multi-dialogues , which requires evaluation of dialogues. The complete annotation schema is summarized in Table 7 .
blocks.zh: 我们制定了两个计划:一个适用于所有遵循指令的数据集,另一个专门用于多对话,这需要对对话进行评估。 表7汇总了完整的注释计划。

blocks.en: For inter-annotator agreement computation, labels A and B were merged into a single positive category. This decision was motivated by the empirical observation that label B often acts as an intermediate or “attractor” category: annotators frequently assign B in borderline cases between clearly correct (A) and substantially problematic (C) responses, making the A/B boundary inherently less stable than the B/C or C/D boundaries. Collapsing A and B therefore yields a more robust three-way agreement setting (A/B vs. C vs. D).
blocks.zh: 对于说明人之间的协议计算,标签A和B被合并为一个正数类别. 之所以作出这一决定,是因为有经验认为,标签B常常是一个中间或“代理”类别:在明显正确的(A)和有实质问题的(C)答复之间,注释者经常在边界中指定B,使A/B边界本身不如B/C或C/D边界稳定。 折叠 因此,A和B产生了更强有力的三方协议设定(A/B诉C诉D)。

blocks.en: In addition to the primary quality label, annotators could flag cases where the instruction itself was incoherent, malformed, or otherwise problematic independently of the response quality. Furthermore, for labels B, C, and D, annotators were required to specify one or more predefined error categories (e.g., hallucination, format error, unnatural phrasing, etc.) and were optionally allowed to provide free-text comments for qualitative feedback.
blocks.zh: 除了初级质量标签之外,注释者还可以标出指令本身不连贯、不规范或与响应质量无关的其他问题。 此外,对于标签B,C,和D,要求注释者指定一个或多个预先定义的错误类别(如幻觉,格式错误,非自然措辞等),并被可选地允许为定性反馈提供自由文本评论.

blocks.en: The annotation was conducted blind with respect to the generation process: annotators were not informed whether a given entry had been produced through translation or generation, nor which model or prompt configuration had been used. This setup was designed to minimize confirmation bias and ensure that quality judgments reflected the intrinsic properties of the data rather than prior expectations about the pipeline.
blocks.zh: 对生成过程的注解是盲目的:没有告知注释者某一条目是通过翻译还是一代生成的,也没有使用哪种模型或即时配置。 这一设置旨在尽量减少确认偏差,并确保质量判断反映数据的内在性质,而不是事先对编审过程的期望。

blocks.zh: 附录C 协定:详细分析

blocks.en: This appendix provides a detailed examination of inter-annotator agreement patterns, focusing on datasets with lower agreement values and identifying the underlying sources of disagreement.

blocks.en: C.1 Multi-FLAN: Synthetic Reasoning Ambiguity
blocks.zh: C.1 多种FLAN:合成理由

blocks.en: Multi-FLAN shows agreement values of 0.93 (French) and 0.90 (German), below the threshold observed in most other datasets. The source of disagreement lies in the inherent ambiguity of evaluating synthetically generated reasoning chains.
blocks.zh: 多FLAN显示协议值为0.93(法语)和0.90(德语),低于大多数其他数据集观察到的阈值. 分歧的根源在于评估人工生成的推理链的固有模糊性。

blocks.en:
The FLAN dataset contains instruction-following examples grounded in multi-step reasoning tasks. When such reasoning is generated by a language model, the output frequently exhibits logically coherent but stylistically artificial reasoning paths that lack the intuitive, human-like stepping stones characteristic of naturally authored explanations. This creates a legitimate grey zone in annotation: annotators may reasonably differ on whether a formally sound but awkward reasoning chain qualifies as satisfying from a training data perspective.
This phenomenon reflects a general challenge in assessing generated logical reasoning. The slightly lower agreement should thus be interpreted not as a signal of annotation unreliability, but as evidence that the task itself presents genuine difficulty in judgment.
blocks.zh:
FLAN数据集包含了基于多步骤推理任务的指令后续实例. 当这种推理由一种语言模型产生时,输出经常在逻辑上连贯但有章可循的人工推理路径,这些路径缺乏自然作者解释的直觉性,人性的踏脚石特征. 这在注释中创造了一个合法的灰色地带:从培训数据角度看,在正式的音响但尴尬的推理链是否符合满足条件的问题上,注释者可能存在合理的分歧。
这一现象反映了在评估产生的逻辑推理方面的普遍挑战。 因此,略低的协议不应被解释为说明不可靠的信号,而应被解释为任务本身在判断方面确实困难的证据。

blocks.en: C.2 Multi-PersonaIF: Incomplete Instructions and Constraint Sensitivity
blocks.zh: C.2 多个人信息:不完全的指导和约束敏感性

blocks.en: Multi-PersonaIF exhibits one of the lowest agreement values (0.88 in French) and the highest proportion of C-rated entries across datasets (up to 25% in Italian and 18% in French). Analysis of annotator comments reveals two main sources of error.
blocks.zh: 多个人信息数据库显示的协议值最低(法语为0.88),各数据集的C级条目比例最高(意大利语为25%,法语为18%)。 对注释者评论的分析揭示出两个主要错误来源.

blocks.en: PersonaIF instructions include explicit formal constraints (e.g., “write in lowercase,” “include the e vowel in every word”). Annotators differed in how strictly they enforced partial or borderline violations: some accepted minor deviations, while others applied stricter criteria. This reflects inherent variability in constraint-based evaluation tasks.
blocks.zh: PersonaIF指令包括明确的形式约束(如“小写,”“在每个单词中包含e元音”). 注释者在如何严格实施部分或分界线的违法行为方面有差异:有些接受轻微偏离,而另一些则适用更严格的标准。 这反映了基于制约的评价工作的内在差异。

blocks.en: A second source of errors concerns prompts that lack sufficient contextual information to be fully actionable. For example, an instruction may ask “How many awards did the actress win?” without specifying the actress, or refer to an unspecified entity. Annotators differed in how they handled such cases, with some treating them as invalid and others proceeding with implicit interpretation. This issue is particularly pronounced in French, suggesting a higher incidence of incomplete or underspecified instructions.
blocks.zh: 第二个错误来源涉及缺乏充分可采取行动的充分背景资料。 例如,一项指示可能会问“女演员赢得了多少奖项?” 没有具体说明女演员,或者提到一个未指明的实体。 注释者在处理这类案件的方式不同,有些人视其为无效,另一些人则采用隐含的解释。 这个问题在法语中尤为突出,说明不完整或规格不足的指示的发生率较高。

blocks.en: These two factors jointly explain the high proportion of C- and D-rated entries. Constraint violations reflect the inherent difficulty of multi-constraint generation, while incomplete instructions indicate a data quality issue that can be mitigated via improved prompt design and post-hoc filtering or regeneration.
blocks.zh: 这两个因素共同解释了C级和D级条目的高比例. 约束性违反反映了多约束生成的固有困难,而不完整的指令则表明一个数据质量问题,可以通过改进的即时设计和后热过滤或再生来缓解.

blocks.en: C.3 Multi-TableGPT: Language-Specific Translation Challenges
blocks.zh: C.3 多表GPT:语言特定翻译挑战

blocks.en: The Spanish subset of Multi-TableGPT exhibits a substantially higher C/D-rate (24%) compared to other languages within the same dataset (German 2%, Italian 2%, French 3%). This discrepancy is notably larger than variations observed across other datasets, suggesting a language-dependent effect in the translation and generation process.
blocks.zh: Multi-TableGPT的西班牙子集显示的C/D率(24%)大大高于同一数据集内的其他语言(德国2%、意大利2%、法国3%)。 这种差异明显大于在其他数据集中观察到的差异,表明在翻译和生成过程中具有依赖语言的作用。

blocks.en: Manual inspection indicates that most errors involve incomplete outputs for multi-step instructions, particularly when both intermediate reasoning and final answers are requested, as well as occasional factual inaccuracies. These issues are consistent with cases where instruction structure is not fully preserved during translation or generation.
blocks.zh: 手工检查表明,大多数错误涉及多步骤指示的不完全产出,特别是在要求中间推理和最后答复时,以及偶尔的事实不准确。 这些问题与在翻译或生成期间没有完全保留教学结构的情况是一致的。

blocks.en: Overall, the findings suggest that preserving instruction completeness in multilingual settings remains challenging for complex, multi-part prompts, particularly in scenarios involving structured reasoning requirements. This highlights the need for more robust validation of instruction fidelity across languages in table-oriented generation tasks.
blocks.zh: 总体而言,调查结果表明,在多语种环境中保持教学完整性对于复杂、多部分的提示来说仍然具有挑战性,特别是在涉及结构性推理要求的情况下。 这突出表明,在面向表格的生成任务中,有必要更有力地验证不同语言之间的教学忠诚。

Every model trains for one epoch with seed 42. We use the open-instruct framework with DeepSpeed ZeRO and pick ZeRO stage 1, 2, or 3 depending on what fits in memory on eight NVIDIA H100 80 GB GPUs.
